limitations: First application policy is HTTP localhost loopback; no public TLS hosting or stable private address.
Cloud public issuance/launch and active release promotion remain disabled; default root grants/compiler pin unchanged.
Durable application run intent, scheduling/reconcile/restart recovery and Studio launch/update remain future work.
No guest import/ABI/profile or production budget increase; no credential/proof/native-parent custody in browser/KV.

One superseded refused synthetic ticket briefly appeared in native tool AX before expiry; retained Cloud receipt records this exception without raw ticket. Final normal-profile flow exposed no ticket in tool output.
No real provider/OTP/LLM requests in this package; all owned test processes stopped.
